charts.title: AU Mic c: orbits around AU Mic
charts.description: The orbits of AU Mic's planets in this map from above, to scale, with AU Mic c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Zicher et al. 2022 (2022MNRAS.512.3060Z), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ZICHER_ET_AL__2022): P 18.859019 d

charts.title: AU Mic c: its transit
charts.description: AU Mic c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (1, 27, 95) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 441420236, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 17-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 17-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
